item.title: 11-year-old girl injured in UTV crash in Chillicothe
item.description: An 11-year-old girl was seriously injured after a UTV crash in Chillicothe Friday night, and the driver was issued several tickets.

item.title: Dee-Mack girls basketball wins first ever state championship
item.description: The Deer Creek-Mackinaw Chiefs girls basketball team won the IHSA Class 1A State Championship for the first time in school history, led by senior Dalia DeJesus' double-double.

item.title: Washington Panthers girls basketball win first ever state championship
item.description: The Washington Panthers girls basketball team won the IHSA Class 3A championship, defeating the Glenwood Titans 33-2 to become state champs for the first time in program history.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his father as supreme leader and Saudi sharpens warning
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates (AP) — Mojtaba Khamenei, a son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named as the Islamic Republic's next ruler, authorities announced Monday, as Tehran widened its attacks across the Mideast to strike oil and water facilities crucial to its desert sheikdoms. item.title: Peoria County Sheriff announces passing of beloved police dog
item.description: Quincy Von Hettlingshohe, an 11-year-old police dog, passed away last weekend after serving with the Peoria County Sheriff's Department since 2016.

item.title: Police reports detail alleged fiscal misconduct at Peoria Housing Authority
item.description: The Peoria Housing Authority's former CFO is being investigated for allegedly stealing $9,100 in federal funds over a period of eight months, and was fired after an internal review revealed financial irregularities.

item.description: PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD) -- Another strong storm system will sweep through Central Illinois on Tuesday, bringing multiple rounds of thunderstorms, many of which may be severe. item.title: PeoriaCon unites comic, anime, and pop culture fans in Illinois
item.description: PeoriaCon, a growing convention held in Peoria since 2019, brings together collectors, artists, and fans of comics, anime, movies, and pop culture from across Central Illinois and beyond.

item.title: Raja Krishnamoorthi makes stop in Bloomington ahead of the March 17 primary
item.description: Illinois Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi is running for the U.S. Senate seat and is campaigning on issues such as rising costs, inflation, housing, childcare, education, and job training.

item.title: One person hospitalized after rain, wind causes semi to overturn in Carlock
item.description: CARLOCK, Ill. (WMBD) -- One person was hospitalized after heavy rain and winds overturned a semi on Interstate 74 Friday.
